title: A receiver method call whose type argument violates the receiver's bound is rejected
expectedDiagnosticContains: type argument `NoName` for type parameter `T` of method `name` on `Holder` does not satisfy the bound `Named`
notes: dsc#101: the receiver declares the bound (`fn (x Holder<T: Named>)`), construction does not enforce it, so the method call site checks the receiver value's type argument against the bound.
